aha_moments.user_pain: Saglik sektoru KVKK denetimine takilma riski yuksek, ceza potansiyeli var
aha_moments.suggestion: Tum mesajlara otomatik KVKK disclaimer, tibbi dokulara tag, gorsel yuklemelere engel

aha_moments.user_pain: Doktor/klinik musaitlik sorgusu yavash, hasta bekliyor, randevu kaciyor

aha_moments.aha_moment: Hasta 2 saniyede musait gunleri gordugununde ve tek tikla randevu aldiginda

aha_moments.user_pain: Saglik niche'indeki klinikler Invekto'yu sadece chatbot olarak goruyor, randevu icin ayri uygulama kullaniyor

aha_moments.user_pain: No-show orani yuksek, klinikler gelir kaybediyor, nedeni anlasilmiyor

verdict.raw_text: Q FORCE PASS: CQ3 false positive (pre-existing WA Analytics context lines), CQ4 architectural decision (micro-service isolation). All real code issues fixed in iter 0->1. All 8 CoVe PASS.

CQ2.evidence: TaskCanceledException logged with SystemWarn + appointment ID + progress count

CQ3.evidence: Q FORCE PASS: WA Analytics lines are pre-existing context, not PKT-2 additions

CQ4.evidence: Q FORCE PASS: GetTenantHealthInfoAsync per-repo is micro-service isolation by design

Q4.reasoning: Disclaimer only on SendMessage, not HandoffToHuman

Q5.reasoning: Past date check + day_of_week match in booking

Q7.reasoning: Error codes consistent in errors.md and ErrorCodes.cs

Q8.reasoning: Photo block only for health tenant + image/* MIME
